fields.description:
Revise the T10 (overlay-infra) rubric to partition routine durable-infrastructure checks away from transient de-risk experiments while retaining every existing MAJOR safety class. There is no runtime cross-criterion suppression by design, so the boundary must live in the T10 rubric text.

## Work
- Edit `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_T10.md`: add this scope clause near the top: "This overlay evaluates the DURABLE infrastructure — the IaC/config that persists. Transient, throwaway experiments used to de-risk a mechanism before committing it — their creation, isolation, and teardown — are out of scope here."
- Immediately after that scope clause, add this exact co-located safety qualifier: "This exclusion does NOT waive the four MAJOR safety classes: a transient apply that is destructive with no safeguard, grants wildcard-admin access, or commits a plaintext secret remains in scope, as does an internet- or untrusted-network-reachable transient service with unspecified human/admin authentication — flag each case." This preserves the current destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and endpoint-auth protections for transient infrastructure.
- Keep the rubric independent: T10 must not name T15 or assign scope to another overlay.
- Add `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/plan-review-T10.eval.yaml` with ten live dataset cases. Five `pass` controls cover: a throwaway loopback probe with scoped teardown; fully specified durable infrastructure; a private-network transient probe with scoped IAM; a transient probe retrieving its secret from a secret manager; and a disposable sandbox whose teardown cannot touch shared/stateful data. Five `finding` controls cover: under-specified durable lifecycle safety; a destructive transient apply risking shared/stateful data; transient wildcard-admin access; a transient plaintext secret; and an untrusted-network transient service with unspecified human/admin authentication.
- Add a ten-item `gold_set` with one condensed `input` plus `label` entry matching each dataset scenario: five `pass` labels and five `finding` labels, following sibling packaged plan-review specs.
- Add offline text-contract tests in `tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py` that lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence. Agentic finding behavior is proved separately by the live criterion eval.
- Extend `NEW_SPECS` in `tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py` with `plan-review-T10`, so the existing tests exercise strict schema validity, registered scorer discipline, dataset balance, and non-empty gold data for this spec.
- Regenerate `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md` from the registry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The T10 rubric contains the exact durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [x] The exact four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier appears immediately after the scope clause.
- [x] The T10 rubric does not name T15.
- [x] The T10 rubric does not assign scope to another overlay.
- [x] The packaged eval spec contains ten dataset cases split into five `pass` and five `finding` labels.
- [x] The packaged eval spec contains ten matching `gold_set` entries split into five `pass` and five `finding` labels.
- [x] `tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py` registers `plan-review-T10` in `NEW_SPECS`.
- [x] The strict packaged-spec tests pass for `plan-review-T10`.
- [x] The offline T10 text-contract tests pass and assert the exact scope clause.
- [x] The offline T10 text-contract tests pass and assert the exact safety qualifier.
- [x] The offline T10 text-contract tests pass and assert the absence of any T15 reference.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the scoped throwaway loopback-probe case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the fully specified durable-infrastructure case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the private-network scoped-IAM transient case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the secret-manager transient case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports pass for the sandboxed-teardown transient case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the under-specified durable-lifecycle case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the destructive transient-apply case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the transient wildcard-admin case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the transient plaintext-secret case.
- [x] `rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3` reports finding for the untrusted-network transient-service case.
- [x] `rebar explain T10` renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [x] `rebar explain T10` renders the four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier.
- [x] The regenerated T10 guide section renders the durable-infrastructure scope clause.
- [x] The regenerated T10 guide section renders the four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier.

## Testing
- Run `.venv/bin/pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_criteria_blocking.py tests/unit/test_new_eval_specs.py -q`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar criteria eval T10 --runs 3`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide`.
- Run `.venv/bin/python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry validate-routing`.
- Run `.venv/bin/rebar explain T10` and verify the rendered clause and qualifier.
